claims.claim: banteg posted on 2026-11-19 that Gemini 4 Neon takes 4th place in his Sokoban eval and that Hydrogen has matched Terra at 7.5x higher cost.
The Sokoban Eval uses 66 rooms in 3 parts of 22 rooms, one scored attempt per model, medium reasoning effort, and per-part budgets of 5 hours, 1,000 turns and 10,000 keys.
In the first race (2026-11-10) Fable 5.2 cleared 66/66 in both conditions; Terra scored 41 keys-only and 43 with Python; Argon 43 and 54.
The first-race write-up keeps no dollar accounting; cost is measured in time, turns and keys.
Gemini 4 Hydrogen list price is $1.50 input / $7.50 output per million tokens; GPT-6.1 Terra is $1 / $5.
On Artificial Analysis's index workload Hydrogen (high) scores 51 at $1.87 per task and 8.3 minutes; Terra scores 51 at $0.96 and 14.2 minutes.
Gemini 4 Neon launched 2026-11-18 at $3 / $15 per million tokens with a 1M context window; Hydrogen launched 2026-11-12.
Neon scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh at $6.44 per index task and 21.5 minutes per task.
Google reports Neon costs 32% less per task than Carbon at default high thinking.
A post relayed by KuCoin reports Astra 6.2 cleared all 66 rooms about 33 minutes after Fable 5.2 for about $20 versus $52, in 540 versus 198 turns.
Argon lost 154 turns in the first race, 105 of them to filter blocks; Opus lost 2h09m to 55 format rejections in keys-only.
